hero.title: Planned monthly content, from first idea to final edit
hero.intro: From planning and copywriting to filming, design, and editing, MATRIX’s monthly content plans combine original production with repurposed archive footage, tailored to the brand’s goals and audience.

items.name: Essential Content Plan
items.summary: A balanced mix of designs, edited photos, motion graphics, and reels to support a consistent presence with varied, planned messaging.

items.label: 3 motion graphics posts:
items.text: Animated visual content for presenting key messages and information.

items.label: 7 design and photo posts:
items.text: Static designs, edited photos, or carousels, allocated according to the content plan.

items.label: 5 archive-based reels:
items.text: Existing footage repurposed through editing and visual treatment to support the month’s concepts.

items.label: 3 newly filmed reels:
items.text: Original videos produced around the ideas and scripts developed in the content plan.

items.fit: Best for: Brands seeking a consistent presence with planned messaging and a steady rhythm.

items.name: Expanded Content Plan
items.summary: A higher production volume for broader messaging and a more active presence, with a larger allocation of newly filmed reels and motion graphics.

items.label: 6 motion graphics posts:
items.text: Animated visual content for presenting key messages and information.

items.label: 9 design and photo posts:
items.text: Static designs, edited photos, or carousels, allocated according to the content plan.

items.label: 8 archive-based reels:
items.text: Existing footage repurposed through editing and visual treatment to support the month’s concepts.

items.label: 6 newly filmed reels:
items.text: Original videos produced around the ideas and scripts developed in the content plan.

items.fit: Best for: Brands seeking broader messaging and a more active presence through higher content production.

items.title: Creative Planning & Copywriting
items.text: Concept development, key messaging, initial visual direction, caption writing, on-visual text, and scripts for reels and motion graphics.

items.title: Content Production
items.text: Graphic design, photo editing, motion graphics production, filming for new reels, and editing of both newly filmed and archive-based reels, according to the quantities specified in the selected plan.

planning.title: Monthly Content Planning
planning.lead: Every month starts with a clear plan, before any piece goes into production.

rows.label: Content Objectives
rows.text: Define the month’s objectives and align them with the brand’s marketing goals.

rows.label: Content Pillars
rows.text: Establish the core themes and allocate content across them.

rows.label: Ideas & Concepts
rows.text: Develop concepts tailored to the audience and brand identity.

rows.label: Content Mix
rows.text: Allocate static posts, carousels, motion graphics, and reels within the specified quantities.

rows.label: Key Messages & Content Angles
rows.text: Define the main message and approach for each concept.

rows.label: Creative & Visual Direction
rows.text: Establish the initial creative treatment and visual approach.

rows.label: Content Calendar
rows.text: Organize proposed publishing dates and platforms in a monthly calendar.

rows.label: CTA Planning
rows.text: Define the desired audience action for each content piece.

optional.title: Optional Services
optional.lead: Available according to the project’s needs and agreed scope of work:

process.title: How We Work
steps: We define the month’s objectives and pillars.
We develop ideas, messaging, and visual direction, and prepare the content calendar.
We write captions, on-visual text, and scripts for reels and motion graphics.
We produce: design, motion graphics, filming, and editing.
We deliver the content according to the quantities specified in the selected plan.

items.q: What is the difference between the two plans?
items.a: Production volume: 18 pieces in Essential and 29 in Expanded, with more newly filmed reels and motion graphics.
Existing footage repurposed through editing and visual treatment to support the month’s concepts.

items.q: Does a filming session count as a content piece?
items.a: No. Newly filmed reel quantities refer to completed videos, not filming sessions.

items.q: Are carousels and motion graphics counted on top of the posts?
items.a: No. Motion graphics count toward the post allocation, and carousels sit within the design and photo allocation.
Content calendar preparation is included. Scheduling and publishing are optional services.

items.q: Can we add page management or ad campaigns?
items.a: Yes, as optional services according to the project’s needs and agreed scope of work.
